notes: First release of the Phone System addon, numbered after the Giant API UK VoIP Reseller Provisioning & Addon Module (2.0.1 on the WHMCS Marketplace) that it replaces: the whole phone-system portal on every VoIP service's page (extensions, numbers, call flows, voicemail, recordings, the app, AI agents and the rest), call billing at your prices, checkout with number choice and a 999 address, number ports, 999 records and the phone estate, all through the Giant Reseller API with your branding
Needs the Giant Reseller module 2.3.1 or later; one zip per PHP version (7.4 to 8.4), for ionCube Loader 15.0 or newer

Checkout: customers pick their numbers (by area or type, memorable numbers with your margin on the setup fee) from a self-sizing grid of tiles, and fill in a structured 999 address, on the product's configuration page; products imported from Giant work as they are ("Telephone Number(s)", "Extensions/Users" and the other usual option names are recognised; any other name goes in the settings), the imported "Telephone Numbers (DIDs)" box is hidden since the picker fills it, and a numbers option marked Hidden still gets its quantity
Checkout: an inclusive-minutes panel that scales with the seats or numbers chosen; when numbers cannot be offered, customers see a short notice and a signed-in admin sees the reason on the page

Call billing: every night the addon collects each service's calls and SMS, prices them at your rates (uplift, exempt prefixes, SMS price, minimum charge, rounding) with inclusive minutes per product, and either adds them to the customer's next invoice or holds them on Awaiting approval, where you can approve with an override, decline, recompute or collect now; Charges, Reconcile, Leaks and a Cron log with Run now
Customers see this period's spend, their inclusive-minutes position and their billing history on the service page; call logs show your price, never Giant's cost

Account pages under Services: Port a number, 999 records and the phone estate, built from the API for the customer's services only; a daily port check emails customers as a port progresses and adds completed numbers to the service's billed quantity; a weekly 999 sweep

Email templates, created if missing and editable under Setup > Email Templates: app login and welcome (sent by you, with your app name and links), port submitted, port update, and for admins the new-billing digest and the high-usage alert

Tax wording follows your WHMCS tax settings and the product's taxable flag: "+VAT" and "ex VAT" when you charge tax on prices entered exclusive of it, "inc. VAT" when inclusive, nothing when you do not charge tax; the tax's name comes from your first tax rule
Every page the addon renders carries its own colour palette, so it looks right on any WHMCS theme, and the new "Accent colour" setting recolours buttons, tiles and highlights to match your brand

Module log: every API call, portal action with what was posted and answered, checkout decision, cron run, billing approval and email is written under "resellervoip" while module logging is on, with passwords, keys and tokens blanked

A signed-in admin sees on a customer's service page why each area is on or off (Giant's product, your Features matrix, areas switched off); the Guide tab lists common problems, and the setup guide's Troubleshooting chapter has the full list with fixes

Known limits in this release: CRM sign-in integrations, estate exports and the optimisation wizard, AI and storage metered re-billing, and extension QR login codes are not available through the API yet and are shown as such
